parsed.why: Local law adds no protections but national border/screening, capital federal facilities, and legislative overrides remain. A low-risk label is fragile; exposure stays near the hostile national line.

Local bathroom ban in schools/government buildings plus complaint/reporting channel creates universal facility/outing exposure; flag ban signals hostility. Private venues are exempt, so high but not Do Not Travel.

No local facility ban and public-accommodation, hate-crime protections are traveler-facing positives; national document/screening and federal facility rules persist, so Elevated Risk, above parent but not Reduced.

Broad nondiscrimination and public-accommodation coverage, no local ban, and constitutional protections raise it above parent; border/federal exposure and unverified visitor enforcement keep it high Elevated.

Most-protective tier: no ban, public-accommodation nondiscrimination, gender-neutral single-user rules, and visitor healthcare shields reduce local exposure; national passport/visa/federal facility limits keep it Reduced Risk.
